A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, thus the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 116 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. Submissions that land within 299 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
